en-US.title: Water Sort - No Ads
en-US.shortDescription: No ads. Find your perfect pour in 1,000 colorful offline water sort puzzles.
en-US.fullDescription:
No ads. No interruptions. Just beautiful glass, flowing color, and the joy of solving.

One more pour. A new possibility. That beautifully satisfying finish.

Watch a tangle of colors become a board you understand. Find the move that opens up space. Send the last color into place, and let the fireworks mark a puzzle solved by you.

This is Bottle Harmony: a water sort puzzle game with beautiful glass, natural pouring sounds and room to think.

A simple touch. A thoughtful challenge.
Tap a glass, then choose another to pour. Bring matching colors together and work towards a neatly sorted board. The idea is easy to grasp; the pleasure is in seeing a plan come together.

Start with a two-color introduction and follow a mainline of 1,000 puzzles, unlocking them in order. As more colors enter the mix, each empty space becomes a possibility. Take a quick puzzle break or settle in for a longer session—there is no countdown to hurry you along.

Make the glass your own
Choose freely from 15 glass container styles, including bottles, test tubes, tumblers and stemware. Swipe on the home screen to find a favorite. The whole board follows your choice, so a familiar puzzle can feel fresh in a different glass.

Keep the momentum
Undo a pour or restart a level for free. Every new mainline level offers one free one-step hint; more hints use credits earned by completing levels. Revisit completed puzzles whenever you want, with free replay hints.

A puzzle to enjoy together
Sit down with your child, compare ideas with a partner, or take turns with a grandparent. Spot a useful move, talk through a plan, and share that satisfying final pour. With no ads and no countdown, there is room to think together at your own pace. Designed for players aged 6 and up.

A little twist beyond the mainline
After each group of 20 mainline puzzles, a bonus puzzle becomes available. Explore 50 bonus puzzles with a frozen bottom layer that you can melt for free.

Color you can see. Water you can hear.
Enjoy the glass details, recorded pouring sounds and a firework celebration when a board is complete. Prefer quiet? Switch the sound off. Optional color-linked symbols give you another way to distinguish the colors.

Just you and the puzzle
No advertising. No account to create, lives to refill or timer to race. Gameplay works offline, and your progress and preferences stay on your device.

A few minutes. A colorful challenge. The pleasure of making it all fit.

Your next thoughtful pour is waiting.

This is a test version. Feedback: admin@readytradie.com.
Progress is saved locally. Clearing app storage or uninstalling removes it; cloud saving and cross-device restoration are not available.

zh-CN.title: Water Sort - No Ads
zh-CN.shortDescription: 没有广告，安心享受1000道离线倒水谜题，15款玻璃容器自由选择。
zh-CN.fullDescription:
没有广告，没有打扰。只有漂亮的玻璃、流动的色彩，和亲手解开谜题的畅快。

再倒一次，就快解开了。

看似乱作一团的颜色，在你手中一点点找到位置。刚才还无从下手的局面，突然出现了通路。最后一股水落进杯中，同色归位，礼花升起——这份亲手解开难题的畅快，就是 Bottle Harmony 想带给你的体验。

漂亮的玻璃，流动的色彩，真实的倒水声。用一个简单动作，开启一场值得慢慢琢磨的挑战。

轻轻一点，思路开始流动
先点一个容器，再点另一个容器倒水。让同色水逐渐汇到一起，直到棋盘井然有序。操作容易理解，乐趣却藏在每一次腾出空间、每一次发现新走法的瞬间。

从两色教学开始，沿着1000道主线谜题逐关前进。随着颜色增加，空位也变得更值得珍惜。可以玩一关歇歇，也可以连着挑战几关；没有倒计时催促，节奏由你决定。

换一只杯子，换一种心情
15款玻璃容器自由选择。从玻璃瓶、试管、水杯到高脚杯，在首页轻轻滑动，就能选出喜欢的样式。整张棋盘统一换装，熟悉的谜题也能有新的视觉感受。

卡住了，也能继续探索
撤销和重来都免费。每道新主线关卡有一次免费的一步提示，额外提示使用首次通关获得的提示券。已完成的关卡可以随时重玩，重玩时的一步提示免费。

一家人，也能分享这份乐趣
陪孩子找一找下一步，和伴侣聊一聊解题思路，或与长辈轮流倒水。一个人慢慢琢磨很自在，一起发现答案也很开心。没有广告和倒计时，让你们按自己的节奏思考、交流，分享最后一倒的满足。适合6岁及以上玩家。

主线之外，还有一点新意
每完成一组20道主线谜题，就能进入对应的副关卡。50道副关卡加入凝固底层，你可以免费融化它，尝试另一种解题思路。

看得清，听得见，也能安静地玩
欣赏玻璃细节与水流，听见真实录制的倒水声，让礼花为通关添一点仪式感。想安静思考时，可以关闭音效。还可开启颜色辅助符号，用形状帮助分辨颜色。

把时间留给谜题
没有广告打断，没有需要补充的生命，也无需注册账号。游玩无需联网，进度和偏好保存在本机。

几分钟，一道题，一次恰到好处的倒水。
从颜色交错，到同色归位，把解题的畅快握在自己手里。

下一步，等你来倒。

当前为测试版本。欢迎通过 admin@readytradie.com 反馈体验与建议。
存档仅保存在本机。清除应用存储或卸载会删除进度；不提供云存档或跨设备恢复。
